scope: contact force/deformation/dissipation records only; this does not measure complete Bullet/chassis/engine/brake energy

force_phase_vs_observation_phase.force_kappa_alpha: wheel slip at tire force solve (force_contact_tick)
force_phase_vs_observation_phase.force_patch_kappa_alpha: contact patch slip at tire force solve (force_contact_tick)
force_phase_vs_observation_phase.kappa_alpha: wheel slip observed after Bullet step (sample_tick)

thresholds.zero_load_and_airborne_force: exactly zero; no tolerance or clamping

protocol.observer: simulation truth; mechanism evidence, no real-car validation
protocol.world: independent horizontal Bullet plane; gravity -9.81; no window
protocol.comparison: same mode car, initial conditions, controls, load exponents and K/b; A compliance false, B true; ABS/TCS/ESC all true
protocol.initialization: once-only speed/pure rolling, airborne +2m or coast yaw +.5rad/s; no runtime edits
protocol.energy_phase: deformation, elastic_energy and force_patch_kappa/alpha are final tire substep at force_contact_tick; force_kappa/alpha same force phase; kappa/alpha are completed Bullet observations at sample_tick
protocol.dissipation: material/road/elastic_numerical/frame fields are Joules summed over tire substeps within one tick; trial sums exclude initial row; no positivity clamp
protocol.energy_scope: contact storage/dissipation only; not complete chassis/engine/brake/collision energy balance; maximum energy is not time-summed
protocol.mode_energy: per-wheel dissipation sums and storage/deformation/force-patch/force-wheel/completed-wheel slip maxima across selected independent trials; not one continuous drive
protocol.outcomes: retain all raw trajectories and deltas; no enforced acceleration, distance or yaw improvement

protocol.comparison: same mode car, commands, initial conditions, load exponents, K/b; compliance and ABS/TCS/ESC on; only tire_substeps 2/8 differs
protocol.energy_phase: energy and deformation from final tire substep at force_contact_tick; dissipation is sum of all tire substeps within each body tick; trial sums exclude initial row
protocol.scope: simulation truth; numerical sensitivity observations only; no new acceptance threshold or real-car validation

road_dissipation_policy: preserve signed raw values and report min/max; negative values are reported, not clamped or treated as material/numerical dissipation
baseline_rigid_evidence: mechanical-rigid/ is read-only and was not altered; Kz+b rate identity is not applicable to tire_compliance=false baseline trials
